changeSet.author: Puneet Gupta
changeSet.sql: if not exists (select * from [INFORMATION_SCHEMA].[COLUMNS] where TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' and TABLE_NAME = 'company' and COLUMN_NAME = 'EnvironmentNotificationEmail' ) begin alter table [dbo].[company] add [EnvironmentNotificationEmail] [nvarchar](500) end
changeSet.rollback: if exists (select * from [INFORMATION_SCHEMA].[COLUMNS] where TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' and TABLE_NAME = 'company' and COLUMN_NAME = 'EnvironmentNotificationEmail' ) begin alter table [dbo].[company] drop column [EnvironmentNotificationEmail] end
